# 0001 — Legacy button label

- Status: accepted
- Recorded: 2024-01-02
- Owner / approval evidence: historical product-owner approval
- Governing spec: [Product](../../specs/product.md)

## Context

The product owner approved renaming the submit button to Save in 2024.

## Decision
